title: Drill-down header shows the work order id plus its line count
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on a desktop browser.
2. A work order exists with a known number of approved lines.
3. You are on the Schedule page.
custom_steps:
1. Click the work order card to open the drill-down.
2. Read the header of the drill-down.
custom_expected:
1. The header shows the work order id.
2. The header also shows the line count, and it matches the number of approved lines.
